bugs: NOTE (not a product bug): the 'Linux Electron prod-flow recipe' in project_desktop_linux_run.md is stale. Since the btree_gist EXCLUDE migration (CLI-408), api `migrate` fails on a Linux box whose system postgres lacks contrib: `CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS btree_gist` -> 'extension "btree_gist" is not available' (Nobara/Fedora: postgresql-contrib not installed). Windows bundle has btree_gist.dll/extension files, so the product is fine. Symptom in Electron: first-run main process hangs forever with no log, because migrateOnStart returns ok:false -> dialog.showErrorBox blocks (invisible under Xvfb); api.log is never created, postgres+valkey keep running. The dialog is shown, but nothing is written to LOGS_DIR for a migrate failure, so a headless/dev operator sees only an empty logs dir. Repro: first run with system postgres lacking contrib. Workaround used: dnf download postgresql-contrib, extract, and wrapper `postgres` on PATH adding -c extension_control_path='$system:<dir>/usr/share/pgsql' (PG18 appends /extension) -c dynamic_library_path='$libdir:<dir>/usr/lib64/pgsql'.

NOTE (environment): desktop Postgres/Valkey ports are hardcoded to 5433/6380 (process-manager.ts, first-run.ts, migrate-on-start.ts), which collides with the dev docker postgres published on host :5433, so the desktop cannot run next to the dev infra. I ran Electron in a private user+network namespace (unshare -U -n --map-user=1000 --keep-caps) with a unix-socket socat bridge to the supervisor on :3195. Not a Windows end-user issue.

NOTE (minor, observed): provisioned owner login with the temporary password returns mustChangePassword:false (login 200, no forced change). Not verified whether that is intended for the activation-provisioned owner (CLAUDE.md says provisioning gives a temp password); flagging only for confirmation.

(b) The Electron prod flow works end to end once the postgres-contrib blocker below is worked around. First run (initdb, postgres :5433, valkey :6380, migrate, API :8080) was OK. Activation returned provisioned:true and owner login returned 200. Switch-workspace and patient creation worked (201). After I created a second patient and called POST /api/backup/restore with the correct confirmName (202), the log showed a pre-restore backup and 'tiklash tugadi' about 3s after the request. restore-result.json said status ok, the API came back, the license heartbeat was OK, and login worked. The patient list then contained only 'Bemor BEFORE Backup' (total 1), so the patient created after the backup is gone. SIGTERM to the Electron main process also stopped postgres, valkey and api cleanly. Two unproven steps: the uploads rollback was not verified (no uploaded files existed), and I did not drive the UI. (c) P17 passes. The api image built from infra/docker-compose.prod.yml. uploads_data mounted at /data/uploads, owned by bun (uid 1000), and a file written as bun survived a container recreate. I removed the containers, volumes, network and image, and dropped the supervisor_v_desktop DB. The only bug-level finding is the stale Linux recipe: system postgres without contrib breaks api migrate on btree_gist, and Electron then silently hangs on an invisible error dialog (details under bugs)."

bugs.title: Concurrent POST /api/appointments for the same doctor+slot: the loser gets HTTP 500, not 409
bugs.repro: Role: receptionist (restricted JWT). Two patients, same doctorId+branchId, identical startTime/endTime (e.g. 2026-11-13T05:00Z-05:30Z), two parallel fetches with Promise.all against the running server. Result: one 201 and one 500 {"error":{"code":"internal_error"}}. Repeated on 5 different slots: every round was 201+500 (never 201+409). 6 concurrent requests on one slot gave 5x500 and 1x201. Overlapping but non-identical slots (11:00-11:30 vs 11:15-11:45) gave 201+500. The same patient posted twice concurrently gave 201+500. The API log shows DrizzleQueryError wrapping PostgresError 'conflicting key value violates exclusion constraint "appointments_no_doctor_overlap"'. The DB itself is correct: exactly 1 row per slot, no duplicates. Only the status code and the message to the user are wrong. In the UI the loser sees a generic common.error, not the conflict message. Root cause: exclusionConflictCode() reads err.code and err.constraint_name on the top-level error. With drizzle-orm 0.45.2 the PG error is in err.cause, so the 23P01 -> 409 mapping never matches.

bugs.title: Same wrapped-23P01 bug in payroll: concurrent POST /api/payroll/runs for the same period returns 500 instead of 409 overlap
bugs.repro: Role: owner. Three parallel POST /api/payroll/runs with {periodFrom:'2026-10-01',periodTo:'2026-10-31'}. Result: 201, 500, 500. isExclusionViolation() checks err.code === '23P01' on the DrizzleQueryError wrapper, not on .cause, so PayrollOverlapError is never thrown. Found while looking for the same failure pattern as FU-01.
